n1.speaker: npc_pell
n1.text: Department Supervisor. They gave you the quotas to keep your hands full. Good. Full hands can carry ledgers.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: Odalys kept a copy of Thrace's key. The shelf behind his desk is Room 0's door. It only turns at night, when he's inside.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: Go after the night bell. Odalys and Quill will be at your back. Bring me the books.
